attribution_aggregation: Mean absolute TreeSHAP over the registered mask-selected explanation rows per seed and all five heads, then equal seed mean within fold and equal mean over informative folds. Field ranking sums its value and age channels. Shares normalize within the appended family only; they are not shares of P&L or proof of causation.
inference: Ten exploratory paired comparisons; nominal 95% intervals are not multiplicity-adjusted. Null screens do not demote neural families; no S0 or economic improvement is established.
